about_the_game:
Go solo or team up with up to three friends. Drive a customizable off-road rig, park, explore on foot, and haul everything back before the cold bites harder.

Scavenge fuel, oil, water, food, batteries, car parts, and the occasional silly find. Your vehicle is more than transport; it is your lifeline. Repair damage, refuel the tank, and upgrade with better engines, heaters, tire chains, and storage. Every item is physical: toss loot in the trunk, strap it down, or load a trailer and hope the bumps play nice.

Trailers carry real survival comforts. Fit bunks, a microwave, radio, and storage. Add solar panels to charge your batteries. Install a resource scanner to locate supplies or a storm scanner to warn of incoming blizzards. Make it cozy, decorate it, and share a tune on instruments you uncover.

Dynamic weather and a full day-night cycle test your planning. Seek shelter during whiteouts, keep heaters running, and watch hunger, thirst, and body temperature.

Key Features

  • 1–4 player co-op: Coordinate roles, share supplies, revive teammates, and keep the convoy rolling.

  • Immersive simulation: Cars and objects have simulated physics. If you can pick it up, you can cram it in the car or trailer. Drift through blinding snow, then step out to explore and haul loot.

  • Procedurally generated world: Fresh routes, point of interests, and challenges every run.

  • Vehicle customization and repair: Engines, tires, decorations, heaters, chains, and more.

  • Survival systems: Manage hunger, thirst, and body temperature. Hunt or forage for food, melt snow for water, and make a fire or let the engines on to avoid hypothermia.

  • Cross-platform play Windows, macOS, and Linux. No one gets left out in the cold!

name: Arctic Drive

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 3.1 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600x 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: First-person survival road trip in a procedurally generated frozen wasteland. Drive and upgrade your off-road vehicle alone or with up to 3 friends, scavenge for fuel, food, and parts, and survive hunger, thirst, and sub-zero temperatures.
